description: Preserved Adria airliner displayed at Ljubljana airport; the OpenStreetMap surveyor records operator=Inex Adria Aviopromet and links a Wikimedia Commons category „Douglas DC-6 of Adria Airways at Ljubljana Airport“; no registration is recorded in the source and none is invented here; this is the one airframe at the airport that is genuinely walk-up
